# Action catalogue

<!-- Generated by `pnpm docs:catalog` from src/catalog. Do not edit by hand. -->

Kestrel Bank exposes **77 actions** across **11 services**.
Each action answers exactly one Banking77 intent. Example messages and counts come from the train split.

| Service | Actions | Train messages |
|---|---:|---:|
| Cards | 12 | 1390 |
| Virtual Cards | 4 | 357 |
| Card Payments | 8 | 1180 |
| ATM & Cash | 7 | 1083 |
| Transfers | 11 | 1581 |
| Top-up | 11 | 1413 |
| FX | 5 | 606 |
| Security | 6 | 631 |
| Identity | 6 | 679 |
| Disputes | 5 | 854 |
| Account | 2 | 229 |

## Cards (`cards`)

Physical card ordering, delivery, activation, renewal and card faults

| Action | Banking77 intent | What the customer wants | Handler | Example message |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cards.activate` | `activate_my_card` | Activate a physical card the customer has received | Mark the delivered card active | "Please help me with my card. It won't activate." |
| `cards.track_delivery` | `card_arrival` | An ordered card has not arrived yet; where is it | Return shipping status and tracking for the latest card order | "I am still waiting on my card?" |
| `cards.delivery_estimate` | `card_delivery_estimate` | How long card delivery takes | Return delivery time for the customer's country | "Can it specifically be delivered on a certain date?" |
| `cards.renew_expiring` | `card_about_to_expire` | The card is about to expire; how to get a new one | Show expiry date and schedule a replacement | "Are there any express fees if i want my new card faster?" |
| `cards.physical_card_info` | `get_physical_card` | How to get a physical card | Explain physical card eligibility and steps | "I'm not sure what to do about the PIN, because I don't have one yet." |
| `cards.order_physical` | `order_physical_card` | Order a physical card, including delivery options and cost | Create a card order | "How much does it cost for a physical card?" |
| `cards.order_spare` | `getting_spare_card` | Get an additional or spare card on the same account | Create an additional card order | "Are extra charges added for sending out additional cards?" |
| `cards.troubleshoot` | `card_not_working` | The physical card is not working | Check card status and recent declines; suggest fixes | "I can't use my card because it is not working." |
| `cards.atm_retained` | `card_swallowed` | An ATM kept or swallowed the card | Block the retained card and offer a replacement | "What do I do if the ATM took my card?" |
| `cards.contactless_troubleshoot` | `contactless_not_working` | Contactless payments are not working | Check contactless status and chip-and-PIN reset | "Should i uninstall the app before i try it again?" |
| `cards.link_card` | `card_linking` | Link a received or existing card to the app | Attach the card to the customer's app account | "My card has been found. Is there any way for me to put it back into the app?" |
| `cards.card_network` | `visa_or_mastercard` | Whether cards are Visa or Mastercard | Return the card network | "Is there a way I can have a mastercard?" |

## Virtual Cards (`virtual_cards`)

Virtual and single-use disposable cards: creating them, their limits and faults

| Action | Banking77 intent | What the customer wants | Handler | Example message |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `virtual_cards.create` | `getting_virtual_card` | Get a virtual card | Create a virtual card | "I would like to order a virtual card, where can I get one?" |
| `virtual_cards.create_disposable` | `get_disposable_virtual_card` | Get a single-use disposable virtual card | Create a disposable virtual card | "What do you use disposable cards on?" |
| `virtual_cards.disposable_limits` | `disposable_card_limits` | Limits on disposable virtual cards | Return disposable card limits | "Do the disposable cards have any restrictions on them?" |
| `virtual_cards.troubleshoot` | `virtual_card_not_working` | A virtual card is not working | Check virtual card status and recent declines | "Why isn't my disposable virtual card working?" |

## Card Payments (`card_payments`)

Payments made with a card: pending, declined, reverted or unrecognised payments, fees, exchange rates, where the card is accepted, Apple Pay and Google Pay

| Action | Banking77 intent | What the customer wants | Handler | Example message |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `card_payments.explain_fee` | `card_payment_fee_charged` | A fee was charged on a card payment | Find the fee and explain why it applied | "There was a fee charged when I paid with my card." |
| `card_payments.unrecognised` | `card_payment_not_recognised` | The customer does not recognise a card payment | List recent card payments and offer to freeze the card | "There's a payment with my card that I didn't perform. I don't know that name shown." |
| `card_payments.fx_rate_query` | `card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate` | A card payment abroad used the wrong exchange rate | Show the rate applied vs the market rate at the time | "Last Saturday, I was charged extra for the exchange rate on my payment. Is something wrong?" |
| `card_payments.declined` | `declined_card_payment` | A card payment was declined | Find the decline and its reason | "I'm not sure why my card didn't work" |
| `card_payments.pending` | `pending_card_payment` | A card payment is still pending | Show pending card payments and expected settlement | "What does it mean when a payment is pending?" |
| `card_payments.reverted` | `reverted_card_payment?` | A card payment was reverted or returned | Find the reversal and explain it | "I wanted to purchase something online but the payment was returned back to me. This has been going on for a couple of weeks. Please tell me what is going on here?" |
| `card_payments.acceptance` | `card_acceptance` | Where the card is or isn't accepted | Explain merchant acceptance rules | "Is there anywhere I can't use my card?" |
| `card_payments.mobile_wallets` | `apple_pay_or_google_pay` | Using Apple Pay or Google Pay | Explain wallet setup and supported devices | "Hi, I have an apple watch. How do I use it to top up my card?" |

## ATM & Cash (`atm`)

Cash withdrawals at ATMs: fees, declines, pending or unrecognised withdrawals, wrong amount or exchange rate

| Action | Banking77 intent | What the customer wants | Handler | Example message |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `atm.atm_usage` | `atm_support` | Which ATMs accept the card and how to use them | Explain ATM support | "I can use this card at which ATMs?" |
| `atm.explain_fee` | `cash_withdrawal_charge` | A fee was charged on a cash withdrawal | Find the withdrawal fee and explain it | "Why is there a charge when I took out money?" |
| `atm.unrecognised` | `cash_withdrawal_not_recognised` | The customer does not recognise a cash withdrawal | List recent withdrawals and offer to freeze the card | "I looked on the app and it says I withdrew cash. I didn't!" |
| `atm.declined` | `declined_cash_withdrawal` | A cash withdrawal was declined | Find the declined withdrawal and its reason | "I tried to withdraw cash and got declined, why is that?" |
| `atm.pending` | `pending_cash_withdrawal` | A cash withdrawal is still pending | Show pending withdrawals | "I would like to know why a withdraw I made for some cash shows up as pending." |
| `atm.wrong_amount` | `wrong_amount_of_cash_received` | The ATM gave the wrong amount of cash | Open an ATM discrepancy claim | "Why did I only receive a partial amount of what I tried to withdraw?" |
| `atm.fx_rate_query` | `wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal` | A cash withdrawal abroad used the wrong exchange rate | Show the rate applied vs the market rate | "The wrong exchange rate was applied to me while pulling out cash." |

## Transfers (`transfers`)

Bank transfers in and out: sending, receiving, cancelling, pending, failed or declined transfers, beneficiaries, timing and fees

| Action | Banking77 intent | What the customer wants | Handler | Example message |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `transfers.beneficiary_rejected` | `beneficiary_not_allowed` | Adding a beneficiary or payee is not allowed | Explain why the beneficiary was rejected | "is there something blocking me from making transfers" |
| `transfers.cancel` | `cancel_transfer` | Cancel a transfer | Cancel the transfer if still pending | "Cancel a transaction" |
| `transfers.declined` | `declined_transfer` | An outgoing transfer was declined | Find the declined transfer and its reason | "Transfer unable to be completed, states 'declined'" |
| `transfers.failed` | `failed_transfer` | An outgoing transfer failed | Find the failed transfer and next steps | "What is happening? I have tried to transfer money 5x already. Is the system down? This shouldnt be happening as this is a basic transfer." |
| `transfers.pending` | `pending_transfer` | An outgoing transfer is still pending | Show pending transfers | "i put in money for vacation and its not showing. i need that money today, how long will it take" |
| `transfers.explain_fee` | `transfer_fee_charged` | A fee was charged on a transfer | Find the transfer fee and explain it | "I was transferring some money to a friend, which I thought would be free, but I see there is a charge. What's up with that?" |
| `transfers.incoming_instructions` | `transfer_into_account` | How to transfer money into this account from another bank | Return the account's bank details | "I want to transfer money. How do I do that for my account?" |
| `transfers.not_received` | `transfer_not_received_by_recipient` | A sent transfer has not reached the recipient | Show transfer status and trace reference | "I am worried that too much time has gone by for a transfer to be completed." |
| `transfers.timing` | `transfer_timing` | How long transfers take | Return transfer times by type and currency | "How long am I to wait before the transfer gets to my account?" |
| `transfers.receive_money` | `receiving_money` | How to receive money from others | Explain receiving and share account details | "Can my salary be received here?" |
| `transfers.incoming_not_credited` | `balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer` | An incoming bank transfer has not shown in the balance | Look for the incoming transfer and its status | "help my money isnt showing up" |

## Top-up (`topup`)

| `topup.pending` | `pending_top_up` | A top-up is still pending | Show pending top-ups | "How long does a top-up take to go through?" |
| `topup.bank_transfer_fee` | `top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge` | Fees for topping up by bank transfer | Explain bank-transfer top-up fees | "Is there a top up fee for transfer?" |
| `topup.card_fee` | `top_up_by_card_charge` | Fees for topping up by card | Explain card top-up fees | "What is the charge for using a Top up card in the US?" |
| `topup.cash_or_cheque` | `top_up_by_cash_or_cheque` | Topping up with cash or a cheque | Explain cash and cheque top-ups | "Help me please, I need to top up cash." |
| `topup.failed` | `top_up_failed` | A top-up failed | Find the failed top-up and its reason | "I think my top-up has failed." |
| `topup.limits` | `top_up_limits` | Limits on top-ups | Return top-up limits | "What is the max amount of top-ups?" |
| `topup.reverted` | `top_up_reverted` | A top-up was reverted | Find the reversal and explain it | "My top up did not show up as shown and my money has disappeared, can you help me fix this glitch problem?" |
| `topup.by_card` | `topping_up_by_card` | How to top up with a card | Explain card top-up steps | "My money I had was gone and I could not get gas!" |
| `topup.verify_card` | `verify_top_up` | Verifying a card used for top-up | Start the top-up card verification | "Do you know how I can verify that I did a top-up to my card?" |
